say: Flying abroad? These five words will get you from check-in to your seat.
ar: مسافر برا؟ هالخمس كلمات توصلك من الـ check-in لين كرسيك.

cine.meaning: the card that lets you get on the plane

say: Boarding pass. The card that lets you get on the plane.

cine.meaning: where you wait to get on the plane

say: Gate. The place where you wait to board. Your flight leaves from gate twelve.
ar: Gate: البوابة اللي تنتظر عندها. رحلتك من بوابة 12.

say: Delayed. Later than planned. Our flight is delayed by one hour.
ar: Delayed: متأخر عن الموعد. رحلتنا متأخرة ساعة.

say: Luggage. Your bags and suitcases. It has no plural: never say luggages.
ar: Luggage: الشنط. وما لها جمع، لا تقول luggages.

say: Window seat or aisle seat? Aisle is the seat next to the walkway. Which one do you choose?
ar: Window seat ولا aisle seat؟ الـ aisle هو الكرسي اللي جنب الممر. أنت أيش تختار؟
